requirement: On the web, connecting ChatGPT Codex shows a code to type on OpenAI's device page instead of asking for a localhost address; the desktop app keeps the browser sign-in

oracle.invariant: POST /api/seat-plan/connect/start {provider: 'codex', surface: 'web'} (or no surface) answers signIn 'device' with userCode and authorizeUrl https://auth.openai.com/codex/device, and never the device code itself. The same start with surface 'desktop' answers signIn 'browser' with an authorizeUrl whose redirect_uri is http://localhost:1455/auth/callback. Claude starts a browser sign-in on every surface; GitHub Copilot a device sign-in on every surface. An attempt finishes the way it started: a pasted address for a device attempt, or a poll for a browser one, is refused 400 invalid and the attempt stays open. The page sends surface 'desktop' when window.tracyDesktop exists, else 'web'; the device panel shows OpenAI's page and the code the broker sent. GET /api/seat-plan/status lists webSignIn per provider: codex 'device', claude 'browser', copilot 'device', key vendors 'key'.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
